Home / FAQ

Frequently Asked

How do I place an order?
Add your fragrances to the cart, press Checkout and enter your name, phone and delivery address. Your complete order is sent to us on WhatsApp and we confirm price and delivery with you there.
Where can I see the prices?
Every product shows its price in Pakistani Rupees (PKR) along with its size. Delivery charges, if any, are confirmed on WhatsApp.
What details are included in my order?
Your order message includes an order number, your name, phone, city and address, every product with the number of pieces, and the total quantity.
Do you deliver?
Delivery options, charges and timing are confirmed with you on WhatsApp when you place your order.
Can I order a fragrance as a gift?
Yes. Our attar oils come in black gift boxes. Message us if you would like a gift recommendation.
How long does a fragrance last?
Our fragrances are made to be long lasting. Performance varies by skin type and by fragrance, so ask us for a suggestion that fits you.
Which fragrance should I choose?
Tell us what you enjoy — woody, fresh, floral, sweet or musky — and we will recommend the right scent.
